text:
Yes this is my bed with mosquito netting above me. Ron was next to me on the right and between him and I had a stereo with music from Montovoni and music from Farenti and teicher and Peter Nero. The book is Ian Fleming who wrote the James Bond books. The Thompson was mine and the helmet. 


I named my son Chris after Chris Cox that owned Agrotech machine and he was in the prospectors motorcycle club. Chris middle name is E and Ian Fleming
